title: Compare with a baseline
summary: A baseline is a simple prediction rule used for comparison. Always guessing the training average is one baseline for a number task.
introduction: A baseline is a simple prediction rule used for comparison. Always guessing the training average is one baseline for a number task. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: A baseline is a simple prediction rule used for comparison. Always guessing the training average is one baseline for a number task.
The output is 4.0. The baseline adds the three labels, gets 12, then divides by 3. It will guess 4 for any new input.
